capabilities: Move notes to folders based on frontmatter property values
Map property values to target folders per rule
Resolve naming conflicts with unique numeric suffixes
Skip notes in ignored folders such as templates
disambiguation: Not a tool for editing or moving frontmatter properties themselves; it moves whole notes to folders based on property values.
extras: The author states the code is mostly AI-written and requests support via Buy Me a Coffee; the README describes behavior but gives no step-by-step configuration guide beyond screenshot captions.
motivation: The author builds small tools with AI to solve real problems from their daily life and homelab.
problem: Obsidian does not automatically file notes into folders based on their frontmatter property values, so users must move them by hand.
summary: Rule-based file mover that relocates notes to folders based on frontmatter property values whenever notes are created or edited.
